dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Pronounced, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the body margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the primary dorsal surface area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency clusters of darker-grey pixels distributed across the mid-dorsal plane, posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Soft, diffuse gradients between the light-grey baseline and localized darker-grey mottling.
